title: 第40章 你来姨妈还洗澡啊？

第40章 你来姨妈还洗澡啊？-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

许默冷哼一声，抓起铁皮桶大步跨向帆布后，冰凉的井水当头浇下，将那股刺鼻的血腥与汗臭冲刷得干干净净。

回到床边，方芸做了些吃的。

她还是简易内搭，脏兮兮的外套歪歪扭扭，挂在凳子上。

许默围着破布，坐在她身边，吃着东西。

成年人的世界就是如此，两人对视一眼，没有脸红，没有询问，只有热烈的吻。

可本以为春宵一夜，却在五分钟后许默一声惊吼中全都打断了。

许默一脸的尴尬，方芸也是捂着身体。

“不是，咱们说，你来姨妈还洗澡啊？”

方芸理直气壮道。

“那咋了？就是因为来了难受才洗的呢！”

许默黑着脸，觉得自己被耍了。

方芸也很尴尬，但孤男寡女，许默能忍到第七天已经是难得了。

怪就怪在机会来的太突然，谁都没反应过来。

两人谁都不说话了。

漫长而压抑的一夜过去。

许默猛地推开门。

光洒进来，许默人傻了。

熟悉的缓坡林地，没了。

映入眼帘的，是一片极其陌生的灰白色喀斯特石峰。

它们高低错落，狰狞地刺破浓雾，简直像是一根根从地底深处强行拔长出来的恶魔獠牙。

一阵强烈的失重感袭来，他低头扫视，心跳瞬间漏了半拍。

原本扎根于泥土的庇护所，此刻竟然被硬生生地“嵌”在了一座石峰顶端的天然石窟之中，脚底距离下方崎岖的地面，足足悬空了二十多米。

“轰隆——”

刺目的闪电毫无征兆地劈落，雷音在密集的岩石迷宫中疯狂激荡，震得岩层崩裂，碎石滚落的回响久久不绝。

营地边缘散落着几具扭曲的尸体。

此刻的画面骇人到了极点。

赖以生存的农场彻底毁了。

碎石与黑泥被一股怪力暴虐地搅碎揉捏成一团，那些长势喜人的浆果丛连根消失，连片叶子都没留下。

方芸裹紧衣服凑到悬崖边，蹲下身子，指尖试探性地按在粗糙的岩石表面。

“石头是冰的。”

“但底下的裂缝里，一直在往外冒热气。”

许默目光一沉，反手抄起墙角的石镐，视线锁定了一块脸盆大小的凸起岩石。

Xu Mo snorted coldly, grabbed the iron bucket and strode behind the canvas. The cold well water was poured over his head, washing away the pungent smell of blood and sweat.

Returning to the bedside, Fang Yun made some food.

She was still wearing simple inner clothes, and her dirty coat was hanging crookedly on the stool.

Xu Mo gathered around the rag, sat next to her, and ate.

This is how the adult world is. The two of them looked at each other without blushing or questioning, just a passionate kiss.

But what was thought to be a night of spring supper was interrupted five minutes later when Xu Mo screamed.

Xu Mo looked embarrassed, and Fang Yun also covered her body.

"No, let's talk about it. Why are you taking a shower when you come?"

Fang Yunli said confidently.

"What's wrong? I just washed it because I felt uncomfortable after coming!"

Xu Mo had a dark face and felt that he had been fooled.

Fang Yun was also very embarrassed, but it was rare for Xu Mo to be alone until the seventh day.

The strange thing is that the opportunity came so suddenly and no one reacted.

Neither of them spoke.

A long and depressing night passed.

Xu Mo pushed the door open violently.

When the light came in, Xu Mo was dumbfounded.

The familiar gently sloping woodland is gone.

What came into view was an extremely unfamiliar gray-white karst stone peak.

They were scattered high and low, piercing the thick fog ferociously, like devil fangs forcibly pulled out from the depths of the earth.

A strong feeling of weightlessness hit him. He lowered his head and glanced, and his heart skipped half a beat.

The shelter that was originally rooted in the soil was now "embedded" in a natural grotto at the top of a rock peak. The soles of its feet were suspended more than twenty meters from the rugged ground below.

"Boom——"

Dazzling lightning struck down without warning, and the thunder roared wildly in the dense rock labyrinth, causing the rock formations to crack and the echo of falling gravel to last for a long time.

Several twisted corpses were scattered around the edge of the camp.

The scene at this moment was horrifying to the extreme.

The farm on which they relied for survival was completely destroyed.

The gravel and black mud were violently smashed and kneaded into a ball by a strange force, and the roots of those berry bushes that were growing happily disappeared, leaving not even a leaf left.

Fang Yun wrapped her clothes tightly and moved to the edge of the cliff, squatting down and tentatively pressing her fingertips on the rough rock surface.

"The stone is ice."

"But there's heat coming out of the cracks underneath."

Xu Mo's eyes darkened, he picked up the stone pickaxe in the corner with his backhand, and his eyes locked on a raised rock the size of a washbasin.
